note: GTA VI story mission data. Schema v1.1 adds regions[], coordinates, and monetary block. Populated automatically from GTA Fandom Wiki when the game launches and the wiki is updated. Pre-launch: empty missions array.

fields.name: string — mission display name
fields.regions: string[] — region IDs where mission takes place
fields.coordinates: {x: number|null, y: number|null} — mission start marker location

monetary.payout_gta$: number | null — base completion reward (monetary_dimension: payout)
monetary.gold_medal_bonus_gta$: number | null — bonus for gold medal completion
monetary.net_est_gta$: number | null — payout minus estimated operational cost

fields.unlock_requires: string | null — required prior mission or property
fields.unlocks: string[] — what completing this mission unlocks
